codex/on-force-crystals-and-storm-water..title: On Force Crystals and Storm Water
codex/on-force-crystals-and-storm-water..description: These storms brew and pulse with foreign energy. If one were to harvest it, surely power awaits.The water they produce, "storm water" as I call it, shares many of those traits.#1 It seems the mystical and the mundane do not mix well. A drop of normal water reacts violently with the storm water.Given enough time, this water would crystallise into what I have named "force crystals". They maintain their originator's properties… interesting. They seem to push away anything that tries to touch them.#2 A force crystal seems to repel any magic cast towards it. This needs study.Unfortunately, all the crystals I've had the luck to source have been impure. It would be fascinating to know what a pure specimen could achieve.Hypothesis 1: A perfect crystal lattice would absorb the magic being focused into it rather than repel it. It must be the impurities that cause the crystals to be this violent.Hypothesis 3: A seed's charge would dissipate much faster than that of an impure crystal.I have reason to believe these can be broken, with consequences.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
